decisions.decision: Order pizza from Domino's on Broadway for the event with a budget of two slices per person and delivery scheduled for 11:45am.

reasoning.claim: Domino's on Broadway offers a deal of $10 per pizza, which fits the budget constraints.

source.speaker: Unknown
source.quote:
Call Domino’s on Broadway- they will give us a deal of $10/pizza. Budget two slices
 per person and delivery for 11:45am (Evangeline & Hugo)
          11.99/Pizza (They said thats the most they can do?)
          16 cheese
          16 pepperoni
          6 hawaiian
          Gluten Free/Dairy Free
          Only vegetables
          $478 dollars 40 cents
          Evangeline - Name on order
